notes: Fr 0.10 target row of the 3D-aware stride (T-005 r4 9.5g), same schema as gait_reference_qp.json plus arm / yaw fields; generated by export_ladder95g.py; do not edit by hand.

conventions.model: Planar sagittal model of Tools/GaitOpt/planar_model.py (same as @v1). q9 = [hip x, hip z, th, a0, b0, f0, a1, b1, f1] with leg 0 = solver leg A (exported as 'swing'), leg 1 = leg B ('stance'). x forward, z up.
conventions.angles: as @v1: hip = a + th, knee = a - b, ankle = b + f (degrees in the legs, radians in q9 qd9).
conventions.forces: f4x2 = [ft, fn] per sole point A heel, A toe, B heel, B toe (N); fn >= 0.
conventions.roles: as @v1; the controller builds the 2N = 80 node periodic cycle by swapping the legs (q: [0,1,2,6,7,8,3,4,5], x + step_length_m), as planar_model.load_reference.
conventions.frame: @v1 fields as before; the @v2 additions are in the solver's absolute frame (pelvis x advances by step_length_m per step).
conventions.units: SI (m, s, kg, N, N m, rad) for the @v2 additions; degrees in the @v1 fields. ptv = J qd, pta = J qdd + Jdot qd of the four sole points with the node central-difference qd and qdd (the controller's reference).
conventions.arm_9_5g: Optional (stride_opt_tc.py --yaw): stance/swing.shoulder_deg / shoulder_dps / shoulder_tau_nm = shoulder flexion (+ hand forward, mech_frame shoulder_L/R flexion sign), its rate (central difference over the nodes) and torque (MN m model, N m here) of the straight arm on the same lateral side as that leg (swing = leg A, stance = leg B); anti-phase pair, arm_B = -arm_A, anti-periodic over a step. Node yaw_mz_nm = yaw moment of legs + arms about the CoM (= required ground yaw moment incl. the moment of the planned shear), yaw_m0_nm = moment of the planned sagittal + lateral-LIPM shear about the CoM, yaw_mt_nm = Mz - M0 = free torsional ground moment, yaw_budget_nm = torsion capacity left in the shared friction cone (kappa-derated); row.yaw = summary.
